remote-lane-no-claude-attribution.run: git fetch -q origin staging && test "$(git log --since='1 day ago' origin/staging -i --grep='Co-Authored-By: Claude' --grep='Generated with \[Claude Code\]' --format=%H | wc -l)" -eq 0

R2-remote-hotspot-config.run: test "$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/comments?since=$(date -u -d '1 day ago' +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)&per_page=100" --paginate --jq '[.[]|select(.body|startswith("<!-- FORGE:TRAJECTORY -->"))|select(.body|contains("hotspot_config_missing:"))]|length' | awk '{s+=$1} END{print s+0}')" -eq 0

release-live-run.run: test "$(gh pr list --state all --head staging --limit 20 --json comments --jq '[.[].comments[]|select(.body|contains("FORGE:GATE_"))]|length')" -ge 1

schedd-upgrade-handover.run: test "$(npx --no-install forgedock schedd status 2>&1 | grep -c 'is not hosted')" -eq 0

implementation-comment-file-overlap.run: bad=0; for n in $(gh pr list --state merged --limit 30 --json number --jq '.[].number'); do files=$(gh pr view $n --json files --jq '.files[].path'); listed=$(gh pr view $n --json comments --jq '[.comments[]|select(.body|contains("FORGE:IMPLEMENTATION"))]|last|.body // ""' | grep -o '^- `[^`]*`' | sed 's/^- `//;s/`$//'); [ -z "$listed" ] && continue; echo "$listed" | grep -qxFf <(echo "$files") || { echo "disjoint: PR $n"; bad=1; }; done; test $bad -eq 0

R4-metric.run: npx --no-install forgedock stats --first-review --json --since "$(date -u -d '14 days ago' +%Y-%m-%d)" | node -e 'const r=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0,"utf8")).query.first_review.overall;process.exit(r.n>0&&r.clean_rate>=0.85&&r.incomplete_rate<=0.02?0:1)'

ceiling-default-set.run: git fetch -q origin staging && test "$(git log origin/staging --grep='ceiling default (#5346)' --format=%H | wc -l)" -ge 1

e2e-prod-only-auto-converted.run: test "$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/comments?since=$(date -u -d '1 day ago' +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)&per_page=100" --paginate --jq '[.[]|select(.body|startswith("<!-- FORGE:NEEDS_HUMAN -->"))|select(.body|contains("conformance.e2e_unverified"))|select(.body|contains("https://"))]|length' | awk '{s+=$1} END{print s+0}')" -eq 0

staging-version-synced.run: git fetch -q origin main staging && test "$(git show origin/staging:package.json | node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0)).version')" = "$(git show origin/main:package.json | node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0)).version')"

stats-conformance-outcomes-alterlab-10mi.run: timeout 600 npx --no-install forgedock stats --conformance-outcomes --repo RapierCraftStudios/AlterLab --since "$(date -u -d '35 days ago' +%F)" --no-cache --json >/dev/null

stats-depth-alterlab-defects.run: timeout 500 npx --no-install forgedock stats --depth --repo RapierCraftStudios/AlterLab --json | jq -e '[.. | objects | select(has("defects_n")) | .defects_n] | add > 0'

adversarial-bench-light-cost-1.3x.run: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const d="docs/eval/published";const f=fs.readdirSync(d).filter(x=>/^adversarial-.*\.md$/.test(x)).sort().pop();const t=fs.readFileSync(d+"/"+f,"utf8");const row=n=>t.split("\n").find(l=>l.startsWith("| "+n));const cells=l=>l.split("|").map(s=>s.trim());const co=cells(row("Cost (USD, sum)")),or=cells(row("Oracle pass rate"));process.exit(parseFloat(co[2])<=1.3*parseFloat(co[3])&&parseFloat(or[2])>=parseFloat(or[3])?0:1)'

release-deploy-live-check.run: for b in $(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches?per_page=100" --paginate --jq ".[].name" | grep "^forge-ledger/r"); do gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/state.json?ref=$b" --jq .content | base64 -d | grep -q "\"phase\": *\"LIVE\"" && exit 0; done; exit 1

release-fixloop-one-round.run: test "$(gh pr list --state all --head staging --limit 20 --json comments --jq '[.[].comments[]|select(.body|contains("FORGE:GATE_"))]|length')" -ge 1
